commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n install -d -m 700 /etc/pki/CA/private
sudo -n sh -c 'umask 077; openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes -keyout /etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA" -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" -addext "subjectKeyIdentifier=hash" -addext "authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always"'
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n update-ca-trust extract
printf 'created_key_mode='; sudo -n stat -c '%a %U:%G' /etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf 'created_cert_mode='; sudo -n stat -c '%a %U:%G' /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

set -eu
cert=/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
key=/etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -text | sed -n '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/,+7p'
cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
key_pub=$(sudo -n openssl pkey -in "$key" -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
printf 'key_matches_certificate=%s\n' "$([ "$cert_pub" = "$key_pub" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
printf 'system_bundle_verify='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$cert"
printf 'trust_anchor_listing='; trust list --filter=ca-anchors | grep -F -A3 -B2 'OS Comparison Root CA' | sed -n '1,8p'
